name: MultiSelect
title: MultiSelect
summary: A tag input that grows from 48px, holds removable chips for each pick, and opens a type-to-filter list with checkboxes that stays open while picking.
whenToUse: Picking several values from a long list: languages a church serves, countries a broadcast partner covers, newsletter topics.
8 or more options. For fewer, use `.check` rows (Checkbox).
Only one value: use Select or Combobox.

props.name: options
props.description: All options, in list order. Selected options keep their place.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected values (controlled), in the order they were added.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new list of values.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder when nothing is selected, for example "Choose languages".

props.name: placeholderMore
props.description: Placeholder once something is selected, for example "Add more".

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts for the list and announcements.

props.name: optionalText
props.description: Tag such as "(optional)" shown after the label.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field, for example the selected count. Linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message under the field. Sets `aria-invalid` and the error shell.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the combobox input. Generated when omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: When set, one hidden input per value is rendered for native form posts.

variantNotes: Filled: chips in the order they were added, then the input with "Add more" and a count in the `.hint`.
Open (`.fm-open`): caret rotates 180°; the list filters as you type and the head shows the match count.
Option selected: `aria-selected="true"` fills `.fm-mbox` `--horizon-blue` with a white tick, text `--horizon-blue-dim`.
Error: `.fm-err` on the shell (`--error` border on `--error-field-bg`), `aria-invalid="true"` on the input and one `.err` line ("Choose at least one language.").

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Picking toggles: selected options keep their place in the list and show a filled box. Do not move them to the top.
Keep the list open while picking; close on Esc, Tab or click outside.
Chips wrap onto new lines; never scroll sideways.
Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip.
The caret ⌄ means the list opens here.
Use chips only for picked values; never as filters or links.
Every remove button is a real 30px button inside the 34px chip; the chip row itself stays 44px+ tall with the field.

accessibility: Each × is named "Remove Amharic". After removal, move focus to the input.
Native names (Español, Kiswahili) carry a `lang` attribute when rendered in their script.
content: Label: "Languages your church serves". Placeholder: "Choose languages" when empty, "Add more" once filled.
Hint: "3 selected · Bibles in 500+ languages on dot.Bible".
List head: "4 matches"; empty: "No languages match. Try the English or native name."
Show the English name first and the native name on the right: Swahili · Kiswahili.
